items.title: White-labeled inference platform launched for NVIDIA Cloud Partners
items.what: Simplismart launched its inference platform as a white-labeled product for NVIDIA Cloud Partners, integrating NVIDIA NIM microservices so NCPs can resell inference on their own NVIDIA reference-architecture GPU fleets.
items.hw: NO - software sold to GPU owners; Simplismart buys no hardware

items.title: Multi-Slurm cluster management with failover and cloud overflow
items.what: SkyPilot added unified resource view, automatic cluster selection, failover and cloud overflow across multiple Slurm clusters from one interface, aimed at the 60% of Top500 supercomputers running Slurm.
items.hw: NO - orchestration software over pre-existing Slurm clusters

items.title: SkyPilot Platform launched with $20M round led by Lux
items.what: Assemble Platforms launched the commercial SkyPilot Platform, claiming 20x faster operation than the open-source project and management of 10,000+ GPUs for 200+ researchers, funded by over $20M led by Lux with Amplify, Coatue and Foundation.
items.hw: NO - funds go to product and hiring, not GPU purchases

items.title: SkyPilot Endpoints: multi-cluster inference behind one URL
items.what: SkyPilot Endpoints serves vLLM inference across every Kubernetes cluster a customer owns behind a single endpoint URL with cross-cluster autoscaling, and cites model caching cutting 235B-class cold starts to under one minute.
items.hw: NO - runs on customer-owned Kubernetes GPU clusters

items.title: AI Persona badge for AI-generated artist identities
items.what: Spotify will apply an AI Persona badge to artist profiles representing AI-generated identities starting mid-September 2026, with badged profiles excluded by default from editorial and algorithmic recommendations unless a user follows them.
items.hw: NO - policy and labeling feature, no compute buildout stated

items.title: Merlin licensing deal for Spotify fan-made covers and remixes
items.what: Merlin, whose members represent about 15% of the global recorded music market across 70+ countries, licensed its independent-label catalog to Spotify's forthcoming paid generative-AI covers and remixing tool.
items.hw: NO - licensing agreement, no hardware or datacenter content

items.title: Talk to Spotify conversational assistant enters Premium beta
items.what: Spotify began a gradual beta of Talk to Spotify, a typed or spoken conversational assistant for Premium users 18+ in the US, Ireland and Sweden on iOS and Android in English.
items.hw: MAYBE - LLM inference at Premium scale, partly external models

items.title: L&T to build 10,000-GPU NVIDIA B300 AI factory in Chennai
items.what: L&T's Vyoma.AI/LTN Compute won a mega order (Rs 10,000-15,000 crore band) to host a single-cluster 10,000-GPU NVIDIA B300 AI factory for Together AI at its 250 MW Chennai data centre campus for training, fine-tuning and inference.
items.hw: YES - 10,000 NVIDIA B300 GPUs in a purpose-built datacenter

items.title: IBM and Together AI sign $240M multi-year inference cluster deal
items.what: Under a $240M multi-year agreement, IBM will deploy the first dedicated large-scale inference cluster on IBM Cloud using NVIDIA HGX B300 systems and NVIDIA Spectrum-X Ethernet, with availability expected in Q1 2027.
items.hw: YES - dedicated NVIDIA HGX B300 cluster procured on IBM Cloud

items.title: Together AI and Y Combinator launch dedicated YC GPU cluster
items.what: Together AI and Y Combinator opened a dedicated GPU cluster for YC portfolio companies, already running at full utilization, letting startups take short-term GPU sprints at long-term rates instead of two-year compute contracts.
items.hw: YES - a dedicated GPU cluster reserved for YC startups

items.title: Torc joins Mila for physical AI research partnership
items.what: Torc became the only autonomous-trucking company inside Mila - Quebec Artificial Intelligence Institute in Montreal, with dedicated on-site research space for generative world models, multi-agent behavior modeling and reinforcement learning.
items.hw: MAYBE - AI research program implies training compute, none specified

items.title: Aeva delivers Atlas C-samples for Daimler autonomous truck program
items.what: Aeva delivered Atlas 4D FMCW lidar C-sample units with 500 m detection range to Daimler Truck North America as exclusive long-range lidar supplier for the Torc/Freightliner Cascadia Level 4 series-production program.
items.hw: YES - sensor hardware moving toward series production

items.title: Torc expands autonomous truck testing to Michigan public roads
items.what: Torc began public-road autonomous testing in the greater Ann Arbor, Michigan area using the latest-generation Daimler Truck autonomous chassis based on the Freightliner Cascadia, coordinated with MEDC, MDOT and Ann Arbor SPARK.
items.hw: MAYBE - trucks and onboard AV compute, no datacenter purchase

items.title: TfL licences Wayve robotaxis for Uber rides in London
items.what: Transport for London granted Private Hire Vehicle licences to Wayve's camera-and-radar Ford Mustang Mach-E autonomous vehicles for the Uber platform, after more than 100,000 Londoners joined the interest list in eight weeks.
items.hw: NO - regulatory licensing milestone, no compute purchase

items.title: Autobrains and Uber to launch Munich robotaxi on NVIDIA DRIVE
items.what: Uber and Autobrains will launch an OEM-agnostic agentic-AI robotaxi program in Munich built on the NVIDIA DRIVE Hyperion Level 4 platform, pending regulatory approval.
items.hw: MAYBE - in-vehicle NVIDIA DRIVE compute, not datacenter GPUs

items.title: Uber to deploy 10,000 Rivian R2 robotaxis with $1.25B investment
items.what: Uber will invest up to $1.25 billion through 2031 ($300 million committed at signing) for 10,000 autonomous Rivian R2 robotaxis launching in San Francisco and Miami in 2028, with an option for 40,000 more from 2030 and 25 cities by 2031.
items.hw: MAYBE - buys vehicles and onboard compute platform, not datacenter

items.title: Flyte 2 reaches general availability as open-source AI runtime
items.what: Union.ai made Flyte 2 generally available under the Linux Foundation after 1.3 million downloads, offering local, devbox and Kubernetes deployment with automatic recovery from OOM kills, preempted instances and GPU failures.
items.hw: NO - open-source software runtime, no hardware purchase

items.title: Flyte 2 open source available for local execution
items.what: Union.ai released Flyte 2 in open source for local single-machine execution alongside a distributed production preview hosted on Union.ai, following 60 releases, 508 merged pull requests and 35 contributors since beta.
items.hw: NO - software release running on existing infrastructure

items.title: Cloudera and VAST Data partner on unified AI factory
items.what: Cloudera and VAST Data announced a strategic partnership pairing Cloudera's containerized lakehouse with the VAST AI Operating System on the NVIDIA AI Data Platform reference design, spanning roughly 60 exabytes of combined customer data and available immediately through both sales teams.
items.hw: MAYBE - NVIDIA reference-design deployments implied, no purchase stated

items.title: Aalborg University builds AI research cloud on VAST platform
items.what: Aalborg University in Denmark selected the VAST AI Operating System, deployed with partner Advania Danmark, for a multi-petabyte on-premises AI research environment expected operational in August 2026, migrating several petabytes off a legacy CEPH system.
items.hw: YES - on-prem multi-petabyte buildout serving GPU workloads

items.title: VAST and NVIDIA ship CUDA-accelerated stack with CNode-X servers
items.what: VAST introduced NVIDIA-Certified CNode-X servers supporting NVIDIA BlueField-4 DPUs and Spectrum-X, distributed through OEMs Cisco and Supermicro, with cuDF/cuVS integration cutting Sirius query time up to 44% and query cost up to 80%.
items.hw: YES - new certified servers and DPUs sold via Cisco/Supermicro

items.title: Verda to deploy NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 in H2 2026
items.what: Verda will deploy NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 and HGX Rubin NVL8 systems across Europe, the US and APAC starting H2 2026, expecting to exceed 100,000 GPUs through 2027, with build partners Arm, Supermicro and Compal under NVIDIA Preferred Partner status.
items.hw: YES - explicit multi-region GPU fleet purchase and deployment

items.title: Verda launch partner for Arm AGI CPU with GB300
items.what: Verda is deploying the Arm AGI CPU as a launch partner, paired with NVIDIA GB300 systems now and the upcoming Vera Rubin VR200 fleet, forming an Arm-native stack from orchestration to inference.
items.hw: YES - CPU and GPU systems being racked into its cloud

items.title: Verda announces new AI data center in Sundsvall, Sweden
items.what: Verda is establishing an AI infrastructure hub in Sundsvall, Vasternorrland county, Sweden on 100% renewable power, sized for NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra and Vera Rubin generations, with Mid Sweden University named as a research collaborator.
items.hw: YES - new datacenter build to host NVIDIA GPU systems

items.title: L3Harris details imaging payload role in Xoople constellation
items.what: L3Harris said it supplies the advanced imaging payloads and integrated systems engineering for Xoople's Earth-observation constellation, developed at its Rochester, New York facilities.
items.hw: NO - optical imaging payloads only, no compute purchase

items.title: Xoople and L3Harris co-develop AI-era satellite measurement system
items.what: Xoople and L3Harris Technologies announced co-development of a satellite constellation with custom optical and sensor design, following seven years of Xoople R&D, announced from San Francisco.
items.hw: MAYBE - AI-native Earth data platform implies ground processing compute

items.title: Zoox begins paid robotaxi service in Las Vegas August 10
items.what: Zoox said paid rides start August 10 in Las Vegas, its first commercial market, priced as a base fare plus distance and time, while San Francisco and Austin stay free pending California permits.
items.hw: MAYBE - commercial fleet scale-up implies onboard AV compute

items.title: NHTSA grants Zoox commercial exemption for 2,500 vehicles yearly
items.what: NHTSA granted Zoox a temporary exemption from eight federal motor vehicle safety standards, capped at 2,500 vehicles per year for two years, clearing paid service without steering wheels or pedals.
items.hw: MAYBE - 2,500 vehicles/year cap implies onboard compute purchases

items.title: Zoox unveils production-intent robotaxi, Hayward plant to 100 weekly
items.what: Zoox unveiled its production-intent robotaxi carrying 40 cameras, radars, lidars and infrared sensors, and said its Hayward, California plant will scale to 100 vehicles per week and up to 10,000 annually.
items.hw: YES - 100 robotaxis weekly each carrying an onboard AV compute stack
